objective: Estimate excess replay and recovery burden relative to a matched historical state and measure downstream continuation after a pre-frozen maximal recovery budget.
downstream_endpoint_budget_rationale: B=10 is fixed before these outcomes because it is the largest parent-protocol budget and maximizes separation of unresolved transition failure from downstream task performance.
repeat_rule: B=0 historical control is deterministic and runs once per arm. Every positive-budget historical control and every B=10 downstream arm runs from a fresh container three times. No recovered tree, transcript, or resolution is reused.
historical_state_construction: At the frozen current base, apply and commit the historical current-task maintainer patch, then replay the same first-parent history while omitting the original integration commit. This uses the identical replay and recovery implementation as candidate states.
candidate_state_construction: Use the same 46 eligible frozen alternative arms and candidate patches as parent protocol 17.
exclusion_reason: The frozen future container lacks Git object 7bde24e9c9b5c5a0e228b4c62c094fced9901c3b for this future; the exclusion is fixed before control or continuation outcomes and applies to every state and consumer.

endpoint_taxonomy.replay_success: history reaches the frozen future base
endpoint_taxonomy.prior_verifier_available: the frozen current-task test patch applies at the recovered future tree
endpoint_taxonomy.prior_verifier_pass: the transported current-task verifier runs and passes
endpoint_taxonomy.downstream_verifier_available: the frozen future-task test patch applies after the future-agent session
endpoint_taxonomy.downstream_future_success: the available future target and regression tests both pass; unavailable is null, never false
endpoint_taxonomy.end_to_end_future_certified: replay reaches the future base and an available downstream verifier passes
endpoint_taxonomy.joint_prior_future_certified: end-to-end future certification plus an available passing prior-task verifier

primary_estimands.historical_excess_replay_failure: paired candidate minus historical replay-failure probability within future, budget, consumer, and repeat
primary_estimands.historical_excess_cost: paired candidate minus historical recovery sessions, tool calls, and elapsed recovery seconds
primary_estimands.downstream_continuation: B=10 end-to-end downstream certification for historical versus each frozen alternative
primary_estimands.future_task_conditional: downstream future success conditional on reaching the future base and on downstream verifier availability
primary_estimands.verifier_missingness: prior and downstream verifier unavailability reported as separate outcomes

inference: Average repeats within state--future arms; use paired repository-cluster bootstrap intervals and exact repository sign-flip tests. Report arm-weighted points and repository-macro sensitivity. The eight selected repositories do not identify population prevalence.
analysis_sequence: Freeze this document and all hashes, run both consumers, validate exhaustive keys and exclusions, then write and freeze the analysis script before inspecting aggregate contrasts.
